charts.title: GJ 1252 b: orbits around GJ 1252
charts.description: The orbits of GJ 1252's planets in this map from above, to scale, with GJ 1252 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Patel & Espinoza 2022 (2022AJ....163..228P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname PATEL__AMP__ESPINOZA_2022): P 0.5182418 d

charts.title: GJ 1252 b: its transit
charts.description: GJ 1252 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (103, 104, 105) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 370133522, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 4-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 4-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
